title: Debug: The Wide-Open Embed
prompt: This page embeds a comment widget with NO sandbox at all, the iframe has no title, and the page's robots meta blocks indexing of a page that should be public. Repair: add a least-privilege sandbox (the widget renders its comment form — scripts and forms), give the iframe a title, and switch robots to allow indexing but still crawl links (index, follow).
boilerplate: Release notes

tests.name: widget is sandboxed
tests.hint: No sandbox means full platform privileges for the guest — the first thing a reviewer would flag.

tests.name: sandbox is least-privilege
tests.hint: Scripts + forms is the whole requirement — same-origin on third-party content is the escalation pair.

tests.name: iframe has an accessible name
tests.hint: Screen-reader users hear 'frame' and nothing else — title is the frame's name.

tests.name: robots matches intent
tests.hint: Public page: 'index, follow' (or no robots meta at all) matches the intent.
